newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl pledges 500 mln DM aid to German flood region.
newsitem.headline: Kohl pledges 500 mln DM aid to German flood region.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday federal government aid to the flooded region around the River Oder would reach 500 million marks ($268.3 million).

"I expect that aid measures that the government has already undertaken, together with those that are still to come, will total an initial 500 million marks," Kohl said in a speech to a special sitting of parliament.

Calling the floods the "worst natural disaster ever faced by newly-unified Germany," Kohl said the government was examining what financial aid would be needed in addition to a 200-million-mark soft credit programme already in place.
The repair of destroyed homes, sewerage systems and roads all needed to be addressed, he said.

Existing direct government grants to the region amount to 20 million marks of emergency aid, with the regional government of Brandenburg, the state most affected by the floods, contributing a similar amount.
